* '''Original''' ([[Leia's Resistance Transport]], 9 November 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (9 November 2020). Players Committee card image, 9 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-leiasresistancetransport-20201109.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Leia%27s%20Resistance%20Transport.gif Holotable commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards”], no mark). Text: “May add 2 pilots and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. When deployed, may ▼ a female Resistance character aboard for free.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 2 January 2023): Players Committee card image, 2 January 2023: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-leiasresistancetransport-20230102.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/fba281d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/leiasresistancetransport.png Holotable commit fba281d “Remastered Sets 13 and P, and 1 AI fix.”], no mark). Text: “May add 2 pilots and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. When deployed, may ▼ a female Resistance character aboard for free.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details and the copyright line “© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.” (the earlier image printed none); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
*: [[File:V13-L-leiasresistancetransport-20230102-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Leia's Resistance Transport (Errata 2)]], 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-leiasresistancetransport.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/leiasresistancetransport.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “May add 2 pilots and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. When deployed, may deploy a female Resistance character aboard (deploy -2 if a leader).” '''What changed:''' “aboard for free” became “aboard (deploy -2 if a leader)”; the card prints the errata mark “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
